g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Does the system behave correctly under the specified rules?
Examples: does missing input block export? Do edits require a
Typical methods: automated tests and manual functional tests.
Can users complete the work they actually need to do?
Example: can a first-time user locate omissions, supply the
missing data and obtain a correct report independently?
Methods can include user task tests, timing and observation.
Obtain these two complementary evidence types separately.
